main_text.p: uit refistere. {§} In epist. ad Sororem Marcellinã. 33.[Non ego me vallabo, inquit, circumfusione populorum, nec Altaria tenebo vitam obsecrans: sed pro Altaribus gratiùs immolabor. Exi-gebatur à me, vt compescerem populū, referebam in meo iure esse, vt non excitarem; in Dei manu, vt mitigaret, & si incentorem putarent, in me vindicari oportere, vel abduci in quas vellent terrarum solitudines. Et in {h}Inter E-pist. 3 2. &c. 33. Concione ad Ortho-doxos habita. Quid inquit turbamini? vo-lens, nunquam deseram, coactus repugnare non noui: dolere potero, potero flere, gemere potero, aduersus arma, Milites, Gothos: lachrymæ meæ arma sunt, talia enim munimenta sunt Sacerdotis; aliter nec debeo, nec possum resistere. Concludit tandem, in singulis vobis Iob reuixit, in singulis Sancti illius patientia & virtus refulsit. Quid enim præsentius dici potuit à Christianis viris, quàm id quod hodie in vobis Spiritus Sanctus est loquutus? Rogamus Augufte[?] non pugnamus, &c. Legantur etiam eiusdem Ambrosij tum Commentarij in{i} Epistolam ad Romanos, tum{k} Apologia pro Dauid. Legatur Paulinus, qui ad petitionem San-Cap. 13.Caput.4.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the word "tere[?]" at the line end after "opor-" (the mark over "re" is unclear). The reference numbers "3 2." and "&c." in the note labelled h, and the section mark "§" in the text, are read from the scan with some doubt. The printed "Jn" in the note is copied as "In" by the i/j rule. The last line is at the foot of this part and goes on in part 2.
